effects.printed_clause: Main Phase/Orchis Tribute Special Summon from hand or GY. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Conditioned Quick Effect Tributes one and summons the handler; HOPT.

effects.printed_clause: If Tributed while controlling Orchis: target opponent monster; take control until end of turn. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_RELEASE delayed trigger checks current Orchis, targets a control-changeable opponent monster and Duel.GetControl's it through PHASE_END; HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Targets an opponent monster and takes control until the End Phase after a Tribute cost.

coverage_override.reason: The Main-Phase self-Summon procedure and the Tributed control-change trigger are the two distinct effects; the shared 'each effect' HOPT sentence is represented in both records.
